description: a giant pangolin as big as a bear, one wide chunky shape filling the whole picture, its whole body covered in big overlapping olive-brown scales like a pine cone or armour, a small pointed head with a long snout and small eyes, a long thick scaly tail, big curved claws on its front feet, half curled up ready to roll, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the animal alone, no branch, no ground, no background, the whole animal inside the picture
